profiles.capture: When the photograph says it was taken, digitized and modified, with the recorded offset and a derived UTC instant.
profiles.device: Which camera body, lens and software the file records.
profiles.exposure: Exposure settings: time, aperture, ISO, focal length and exposure compensation.
profiles.rights: Creator, copyright notice and rights web statement.
profiles.location: GPS position, altitude, direction, datum and UTC stamps, plus named city and country.

capturedLocal.label: Capture time (local wall time)
capturedLocal.description: When the file says the photograph was taken, as camera-recorded wall time without a zone (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS), from EXIF DateTimeOriginal, XMP photoshop:DateCreated and IPTC 2:55 with 2:60. Absent means no source records it; a wrong camera clock is still a well-formed value. Cross-source disagreement makes it ambiguous. Independent proof: decoded from the bytes and anchored to ExifTool.

capturedSubSecond.label: Capture time fraction of a second
capturedSubSecond.description: The decimal digits after the second of the capture time (EXIF SubSecTimeOriginal or the XMP fraction), kept as text so leading zeros survive. Absent when no source records a fraction. It is not added to capturedLocal.

capturedOffset.label: Recorded UTC offset of the capture time
capturedOffset.description: The UTC offset the file records for the capture time, as +HH:MM within -12:00 to +14:00 (EXIF OffsetTimeOriginal, XMP date suffix, IPTC 2:60). -00:00 means unknown and is unreadable rather than UTC. Absent means no offset is recorded and no zone is inferred.

capturedUtc.label: Capture instant in UTC (derived)
capturedUtc.description: The capture instant in UTC, derived by exact arithmetic only when capturedLocal and capturedOffset are both present and agree across sources. Absent when either is missing; ambiguous or unreadable inputs make it the same. It inherits the doubts of a camera clock.

digitizedLocal.label: Digitization time (local wall time)
digitizedLocal.description: When the file says it was digitized or created as a digital file (EXIF DateTimeDigitized, XMP xmp:CreateDate), local wall time without a zone. It can differ from the capture time for scans. Independent proof.

modifiedLocal.label: Metadata modification time (local wall time)
modifiedLocal.description: When the metadata says it was last modified (EXIF DateTime in IFD0, XMP xmp:ModifyDate), local wall time without a zone. It is a recorded value, never a filesystem time.

cameraMake.label: Camera make
cameraMake.description: The camera manufacturer text recorded in the file (EXIF Make, XMP tiff:Make), exactly as written. Device identity class: it can narrow who took a photo. Absent when not recorded; XMP and EXIF disagreeing makes it ambiguous.

cameraModel.label: Camera model
cameraModel.description: The camera model text recorded in the file (EXIF Model, XMP tiff:Model), exactly as written. Device identity class. Absent when not recorded.

software.label: Software recorded in the file
software.description: The software text in EXIF Software (often an editor or firmware string). It shows what last wrote the tag, not who edited the image. Device identity class.

lensMake.label: Lens make
lensMake.description: The lens manufacturer text in EXIF LensMake. Device identity class. Absent when the camera does not record it.

lensModel.label: Lens model
lensModel.description: The lens model text in EXIF LensModel. Device identity class. Absent when the camera does not record it.

bodySerialNumber.label: Camera body serial number
bodySerialNumber.description: The camera body serial number in EXIF BodySerialNumber. Device identity class: it can link photos to one body and owner; consider it before sharing. Absent when not recorded.

lensSerialNumber.label: Lens serial number
lensSerialNumber.description: The lens serial number in EXIF LensSerialNumber. Device identity class; it can link photos to one lens. Absent when not recorded.

exposureTime.label: Exposure time
exposureTime.description: Exposure time in seconds (EXIF ExposureTime), a positive rational published as a number with an exact n/d text. Unitless-looking values are seconds. A zero denominator is unreadable.

fNumber.label: Aperture f-number
fNumber.description: The aperture f-number (EXIF FNumber), a rational such as 2.8. It has no unit. Absent for lenses that do not report it.

isoSpeed.label: ISO speed
isoSpeed.description: The ISO speed rating (EXIF ISOSpeedRatings / PhotographicSensitivity), one integer. One integer; several values are unreadable rather than guessed.

focalLength.label: Focal length
focalLength.description: The actual focal length in millimetres (EXIF FocalLength), a rational. It is not the 35 mm equivalent.

focalLength35mm.label: Focal length, 35 mm equivalent
focalLength35mm.description: The 35 mm-equivalent focal length in millimetres (EXIF FocalLengthIn35mmFormat), one integer, as recorded.

exposureBias.label: Exposure compensation
exposureBias.description: Exposure compensation in EV steps (EXIF ExposureBiasValue), a signed rational; negative is darker.

title.label: Title
title.description: A short title (IPTC 2:5 ObjectName, XMP dc:title x-default). Descriptive text: it can name people or places. Only the x-default language is read; other languages alone are unsupported.

description.label: Description or caption
description.description: The caption or description (EXIF ImageDescription, IPTC 2:120, XMP dc:description x-default). Descriptive text that can name people or places. Disagreeing sources make it ambiguous; none is preferred.

keywords.label: Keywords
keywords.description: Keywords as a list (IPTC 2:25 repeated, XMP dc:subject), order preserved and not de-duplicated. They can name people or places. Equal lists in the same order are consistent; any difference is a conflict.

rating.label: Rating
rating.description: The XMP xmp:Rating integer, as recorded (the value is not range-checked). Not an authenticity or quality claim.

creator.label: Creator
creator.description: The creator names as a list (EXIF Artist as one entry, IPTC 2:80 repeated, XMP dc:creator). Personal identity class: it names a person. A recorded creator is a claim by the file, not proof of authorship.

copyright.label: Copyright notice
copyright.description: The copyright notice (EXIF Copyright with its strings joined by a line feed, IPTC 2:116, XMP dc:rights x-default). Personal identity class. A notice is not a licence or proof of ownership.

rightsUrl.label: Rights web statement
rightsUrl.description: The rights web statement URL (XMP xmpRights:WebStatement), text as recorded; it is not fetched or checked.

gpsLatitude.label: GPS latitude
gpsLatitude.description: Latitude in signed decimal degrees, north positive, from three unsigned degree/minute/second rationals and the N/S reference (EXIF GPS IFD, CIPA DC-008). A missing or invalid reference is unreadable. Location class. The datum is the separate gpsDatum field; nothing is converted.

gpsLongitude.label: GPS longitude
gpsLongitude.description: Longitude in signed decimal degrees, east positive, from three unsigned degree/minute/second rationals and the E/W reference (EXIF GPS IFD). Location class. The datum is gpsDatum; nothing is converted.

gpsAltitude.label: GPS altitude
gpsAltitude.description: Altitude in metres: negative when GPSAltitudeRef is 1 (below sea level), positive when 0 or when the reference is absent (the Exif default). The file does not say which sea level. Location class.
gpsAltitude.unit: metres relative to the recorded reference (negative below sea level)

gpsDirection.label: Image direction
gpsDirection.description: The direction the camera faced, degrees clockwise from 0 up to but not including 360 (EXIF GPSImgDirection). Read it with gpsDirectionReference. Location class.
gpsDirection.unit: degrees clockwise from the reference north

gpsDirectionReference.label: Image direction reference
gpsDirectionReference.description: Whether gpsDirection is relative to true north (T) or magnetic north (M), published as true or magnetic. Absent means the file did not say, not that it is true north.

gpsDatum.label: Recorded geodetic datum
gpsDatum.description: The geodetic datum text the GPS receiver recorded (EXIF GPSMapDatum, for example WGS-84), exactly as written. Absent means unspecified: Schemaxis never infers WGS-84 and never converts datums.

gpsUtcDate.label: GPS UTC date
gpsUtcDate.description: The GPS date stamp (EXIF GPSDateStamp, UTC) as YYYY-MM-DD, calendar-validated. Location class because it ties the file to a GPS fix.

gpsUtcTime.label: GPS UTC time of day
gpsUtcTime.description: The GPS time stamp (EXIF GPSTimeStamp, UTC) as HH:MM:SS. Fractional-second components are unsupported rather than rounded. Location class.

gpsUtc.label: GPS UTC instant (derived)
gpsUtc.description: The GPS UTC instant, derived only when gpsUtcDate and gpsUtcTime are both present. It is the receiver's clock, which can differ from the camera clock; the audit compares them.

locationCity.label: Named city
locationCity.description: The named city text (IPTC 2:90, XMP photoshop:City). Location class and descriptive: it is text a person or software wrote, not a verified place.

locationCountry.label: Named country or primary location
locationCountry.description: The named country or primary location text (IPTC 2:101, XMP photoshop:Country). Location class; it is not verified against the GPS position.

orientation.label: Stored orientation
orientation.description: The stored EXIF orientation code 1 to 8 (IFD0 Orientation, XMP tiff:Orientation) with its label. Pixels are not rotated by reading it; a viewer that ignores it shows the image sideways.

imageWidth.label: Frame width
imageWidth.description: The frame width in pixels from the JPEG frame header (not EXIF PixelXDimension). Unsupported for an XMP sidecar, which has no frame.

imageHeight.label: Frame height
imageHeight.description: The frame height in pixels from the JPEG frame header. Unsupported for an XMP sidecar, which has no frame.
